response.sql: WITH media_averages AS (SELECT m.Name AS media_type_name, AVG(t.UnitPrice) AS average_list_price, AVG(CAST(t.Bytes AS REAL) / NULLIF(t.Milliseconds, 0)) AS average_bytes_per_millisecond FROM Track AS t JOIN MediaType AS m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId WHERE t.Bytes >= 10323804 GROUP BY m.Name), overall AS (SELECT AVG(average_bytes_per_millisecond) AS across_media_type_average FROM media_averages) SELECT media_type_name, average_list_price, average_bytes_per_millisecond, average_bytes_per_millisecond / across_media_type_average AS relative_average FROM media_averages CROSS JOIN overall WHERE across_media_type_average IS NOT NULL
